script: If she texts you I'm busy, talk later, and you reply with this, she'll be looking for you all day. Never say Sure, let me know when you can. That puts you on a waiting list. Reply with this: Sure, go do your thing. I just thought of something curious about you. I'll tell you later. Or say: Good. You are getting way too distracted by me. Go focus. That flips the script on him. Comment BUSY, and I'll send you my free playbook. It shows you exactly what to text now.
